title: Not what I thought it would be
text: Not what I thought it would be. This is a nice shower curtain but the fabric is not as rich in color as I expected.  The fabric is stiff, so not as soft as would have liked.  The pattern is ok, but again not exactly what I expected.  This just is not my style.
